Chapter 7 - Classes and Methods / CyberSession

ShowLogWindow

Displays the log window. 
void ShowLogWindow ();
DISCUSSION
This method displays the log window if it is not already displayed. This method calls the log extension's ShowLogWindow method.

Do not subclass this class.

The IsLogWindowShown method (page 368).
